description: Describes merge behaviour for future enrichment phases. Specifies provider priority, conflict resolution, and field-level merge precedence. Configuration only — no merge engine is implemented.

provider_priority.notes: Highest priority. Authoritative source for all railway datasets.
Second priority. Official IT systems data source.
Regional authority. Authoritative for Southern Railway zone data.
Supplementary source. Used to fill gaps in primary data.
Verification only. Used for cross-reference, not as primary data.
Verification only. Used for cross-reference, not as primary data.

station_master.notes: Primary provider fields take precedence. Supplementary providers fill empty fields only.

station_codes.notes: Station codes are authoritative from Indian Railways. No overwriting permitted.

railway_zones.notes: Zone definitions are authoritative. No overwriting permitted.

railway_divisions.notes: Division definitions are authoritative. No overwriting permitted.

train_master.notes: Train data may be updated frequently. Prefer latest data; fill empty fields from supplementary.

station_categories.notes: Category classification is authoritative. No overwriting permitted.

station_status.notes: Status is time-sensitive. Prefer latest available data.

notes: Merge policy registry. Describes how data from multiple providers should be merged for each dataset. No merge engine is implemented. These policies will be consumed by future enrichment phases.
